requirements: 917 AC1: A customer resetting a password needs at least 12 characters, the same as at sign-up.
917 AC2: A signed-in customer changing their password needs at least 12 characters.
917 AC3: The page and the server give the same message about the minimum.
917 AC4: Existing shorter passwords keep working until their owner changes them.
964 AC1: On staging, sign-up, reset and change password each refuse a password that misses any of the five rules, and say which rule is missing.
964 AC2: A password that meets all five rules is accepted on all three.
964 AC3: Customers whose existing password breaks the new rules can still sign in.
